trips.route_note: Direct intercity buses/furgons depart from Tirana's regional bus terminals and take roughly two to two and a half hours to Berat, arriving near the center.
trips.why: Direct intercity buses and furgons reach Berat in roughly two to two and a half hours, arriving near the center.
know: Allow a full day; the old town and castle take hours
Wear sturdy shoes for the cobbled climb to the castle

trips.route_note: Frequent minibuses/furgons leave from Tirana's northern bus terminal and run directly to Krujë in under an hour, dropping you in the town center near the bazaar.
trips.why: Frequent furgons run direct from Tirana's northern bus terminal in under an hour, dropping you in the town center near the bazaar.
know: Skanderbeg Museum and the bazaar are the main draws
Go on a clear day for views toward the coast

trips.route_note: Frequent buses and furgons run from central Tirana to Durrës in about 45 minutes to an hour along the coast road.
trips.why: Frequent buses and furgons cover the 38 km coast road in about 40 minutes to an hour.
know: Roman amphitheatre and archaeological museum are the highlights
Summer weekends are crowded at the beach

problems: Gjirokastër: 210 min by road, dropped (too far for a day trip)
